facts.text: Serve the beans when Rorschach eats them cold from the tin.
facts.why: Neither the Wikipedia plot, the Wikiquote page nor the Fandom and TV Tropes pages I opened mention Rorschach eating beans. The beans and sugar cubes are from the comic, and I could not confirm the film keeps them.
facts.fix: Serve the beans when Rorschach visits Dan's basement to warn him someone is killing the old team.

facts.why: Gunga Diner is the comic's curry house. None of the film sources I opened mention it, so I cannot say it appears in the film. The 1985 New York setting and the curry before midnight joke are fine.

facts.text: Rorschach would rather pocket the sugar cubes.
facts.why: The sugar cubes belong to the comic. No source I opened shows the film has Rorschach taking them.
facts.fix: Rorschach would rather eat it cold from the tin.

vibe.verdict: Good 1985 mood and the smiley badge, but the diner and the beans come from the comic more than the film.
